_comment: Weight manifest. Weights are NEVER committed to this repo -- they are fetched
from Hugging Face at install time by scripts/fetch_models.py.
Every entry is pinned to a commit SHA rather than 'main'. A floating pointer
means a user installing tomorrow gets different weights from one installing
today, with no way to tell which they have when a bug is reported.
The Indic model is AI4Bharat's OWN export, used as published. An earlier
revision of this file pointed at a third party's repackaged conversion; that
is gone. asr.py loads encoder.onnx + the RNN-T graphs + vocab.json directly,
which only the official layout provides.
'tree' means: enumerate the repo directory at the pinned SHA over the HF API
and fetch everything in it. encoder.onnx is a 2.8 MB skeleton that references
368 external tensor files by name, so naming files individually here would be
unmaintainable and would silently break if upstream re-sharded.
